sources.name: Wikidata and Wikipedia
sources.freeLimit: $0; keyless public API with polite-use limits
sources.termsNote: Use the public API with a named User-Agent, bounded category reads, maxlag and cached records. Wikipedia text stays attributed under CC BY-SA; Wikidata facts are CC0.

sources.name: The Odds API free plan
sources.freeLimit: 500 credits per month; the stored remaining-credit guard stops at zero
sources.termsNote: Use one region and one market. The runtime reads the quota headers and refuses the next call when no free credit remains.

sources.name: Cito UFC API free plan
sources.freeLimit: 500 calls per month, 200 per day and 10 per minute; each run reserves at most two calls
sources.termsNote: The runtime keeps conservative monthly and daily counters and stops before a run that could cross either free limit.

sources.name: Owner-reviewed import
sources.termsNote: Every row needs source references and owner review. The importer rejects malformed rows and writes the canonical bout history once.

sources.name: UFC and Oktagon public pages
sources.termsNote: No automated reader is enabled. Approve a written terms review before adding either organization host to the intake.
